title: The Best Time to Visit Peru and 9 Amazing Places to Visit

seo.title: The Best Time to Visit Peru and 9 Amazing Places to Visit
seo.description: The best time to visit Peru is from May to September. Explore Machu Picchu, the Amazon and enjoy festivals with less crowds and good weather - plan now!
